project_title: QuantFolio - StrategyQuant-Style MT5 Portfolio Backtest Analyser

theme_strategy.description: High-density, professional quantitative trading dashboard. Deep dark obsidian background (#0B0F19) with crisp glass/card surfaces, tactical emerald greens for net profits, high-contrast ruby red for drawdowns, and precise cyan/indigo lines for combined equity curves.

typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

rules.headings: Use uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold for section titles and metric labels (e.g. text-xs tracking-widest text-slate-400). Never exceed text-4xl for main hero title.
rules.numbers_and_metrics: Use font-mono for all tabular monetary figures, trade counts, percentages, and timestamp deal logs to prevent layout jitter.
rules.hierarchy: Hero Title: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold; Section Headers: text-lg sm:text-xl font-semibold; KPI Values: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-mono font-bold; Subtitles/Labels: text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground.

layout_and_spacing.container_padding: p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 space-y-6 max-w-[1600px] mx-auto

key_features_and_components.name: HeaderBar
key_features_and_components.description: Sticky top bar with glassmorphic backdrop, branding logo ('QUANTFOLIO'), sample MT5 reports loader button, clear all button, export CSV report, starting deposit input, and light/dark theme toggle.

key_features_and_components.name: ReportUploaderDropzone
key_features_and_components.description: Drag and drop zone for multiple MT5 HTML files with fallback file picker and instant pre-built sample dataset loader buttons (e.g., 'Load 4 FX Strategies Sample'). Parses MT5 HTML tables in browser using DOMParser or Regex to extract metadata and deal timestamps.

key_features_and_components.name: CombinedKpiGrid
key_features_and_components.description: Grid of 5 executive metric cards: Total Combined Net Profit (with ROI %), True Chronological Max Drawdown ($ and % with peak-to-trough timestamp), Combined Profit Factor, Total Combined Deals/Trades, and Total Active Strategies count.

key_features_and_components.name: CombinedEquityChart
key_features_and_components.description: Recharts interactive Area/Line chart combining all enabled strategies deal-by-deal chronologically starting from user custom initial deposit. Includes drawdown underwater curve overlay, date range slider/brush, and strategy toggle comparison.

key_features_and_components.name: PerReportTable
key_features_and_components.description: Shadcn Table displaying each uploaded MT5 backtest report: Checkbox toggle to include/exclude in portfolio, Report Name, Symbol, Period, Total Trades, Net Profit, Profit Factor, Individual Max Drawdown %, Weight Multiplier input (0.5x to 3x), and action menu (Remove/View details).

key_features_and_components.name: MonthlyPerformanceMatrix
key_features_and_components.description: Year-by-Month heatmap table showing profit ($ or %) for each month across combined strategies with total year summary column and best/worst month indicators.

key_features_and_components.name: WorstBestDaysList
key_features_and_components.description: Detailed log of top chronological drawdown days (e.g. 10 Sept where multiple strategies hit Stop Loss simultaneously), highlighting overlapping deal timestamps and cumulative daily drawdown impact.

mt5_parser_technical_spec.parse_method: Client-side browser parsing using DOMParser and regex matching for standard MetaTrader 5 backtest HTML structure.
extracted_fields: Deal Table (Open/Close Time, Ticket, Type, Volume, Price, Profit, Balance)
mt5_parser_technical_spec.chronological_aggregation_algorithm: Sort all deals across all active strategies chronologically by close time (or open time). Maintain a running balance starting from the user-defined portfolio starting balance. At each deal timestamp, compute cumulative portfolio balance = initial_balance + sum(deal_profit * strategy_weight). Peak balance is tracked dynamically to compute exact peak-to-trough True Max Drawdown in dollar and percentage terms.

testing_and_data_testids.rule: ALL interactive components, inputs, buttons, tables, metric cards, and chart containers MUST include explicit data-testid attributes.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, high-density tactical quantitative frontends that feel like Bloomberg / StrategyQuant X.
Dark colors look good when used independently without muddy full-screen gradients.
Do NOT center align the main application container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned). Maintain left-aligned, crisp grid layout.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or crisp rectangular with glow/active states).
Never use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡 for UI icons. Use Lucide icons like TrendingUp, ShieldAlert, BarChart3, Layers, FileText, Download, Play, Check, Crosshair.
Ensure 2-3x generous internal padding inside card components to prevent text collision with borders.
Every metric card and interactive element MUST have data-testid attributes.

Provide built-in sample MT5 reports (at least 3 realistic strategies: e.g. 'EURUSD Trend Follower H1', 'GBPUSD Breakout M15', 'XAUUSD Mean Reversion H4') with realistic deal timestamps so the dashboard is immediately populated with interactive data upon clicking 'Load Sample Data'.
